mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances with UNRATE increase > 0.3pp, or Rank IC over 3-year windows drops below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction that forecasts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with joint HOUST and RSAFS declines, or interaction Rank IC over 5-year windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production signals manufacturing supply chain disruptions that increase input costs and reduce corporate margins, forecasting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of INDPRO decline periods, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts indicates improving consumer confidence and residential investment, forecasting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as it signals stronger economic activity and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of HOUST rise periods, or Rank IC over 2-year windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase exceeding 3.0% signals accelerating inflation that triggers monetary policy tightening, forecasting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% instances, or Rank IC over 5-year windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls and rising unemployment signal severe labor market contraction that reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue, forecasting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with joint PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise, or interaction Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A regime of rising interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) combined with high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%) forecasts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate investment and consumer spending.
regime_hint: high inflation and monetary tightening regime
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or interaction Rank IC over 5-year windows falls below 0.02.
